description: Create a small game and run it with your installed LÖVE runtime.

panels.title: Game development
panels.text: Open your game folder, save your files, then run the game. Set runtime to your installed LÖVE executable. Language completion uses the separate Lua extension and LuaLS.

files.main.lua:
local player = { x = 400, y = 280, speed = 240 }

function love.load()
    love.window.setTitle("Hulder LÖVE starter")
    love.window.setMode(800, 600)
end

function love.update(dt)
    if love.keyboard.isDown("left", "a") then player.x = player.x - player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("right", "d") then player.x = player.x + player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("up", "w") then player.y = player.y - player.speed * dt end
    if love.keyboard.isDown("down", "s") then player.y = player.y + player.speed * dt end
    player.x = math.max(20, math.min(780, player.x))
    player.y = math.max(100, math.min(580, player.y))
end

function love.draw()
    love.graphics.clear(0.07, 0.12, 0.11)
    love.graphics.setColor(0.90, 0.86, 0.72)
    love.graphics.print("HULDER / LOVE", 28, 24, 0, 2, 2)
    love.graphics.print("Move with arrow keys or WASD. Escape to quit.", 28, 64)
    love.graphics.setColor(0.41, 0.78, 0.62)
    love.graphics.circle("fill", player.x, player.y, 18)
end

function love.keypressed(key)
    if key == "escape" then love.event.quit() end
end
files.README.md:
# LÖVE starter

Open this folder in Hulder. Install the Lua language extension and LuaLS for completion and diagnostics. Enable the LÖVE game tools add on and select Run game.

Move with arrow keys or WASD. Escape closes the game.

For full LÖVE API completion, install matching LuaCATS definitions separately and add their location to workspace.library in .luarc.json.
